output.reason: The letter raises the maximum wage used to calculate Jaminan Pensiun contributions for 2024 from Rp9,559,600 to Rp10,042,300. The employee's share of the JP contribution (iuran pensiun) is deductible when computing PPh 21 for permanent employees, so a higher cap changes the deduction amount for employees earning above the old cap. The new cap applies from contributions paid for March 2024. No end date is stated, although the cap is adjusted every year.
